Students Who Study Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) in Postsecondary Education (NCES 2009-161). U.S. Department of Education. Washington, DC: National Center for Education Statistics. https://nces.ed.gov/pubsearch/pubsinfo.asp?pubid=2009161.  See T5CSTEM3FLG for further information about specific CCM codes used to indicate STEM courses based on the NCES grant definition. The 2010 College Course Map (CCM) is used to code these data. See https://nces.ed.gov/surveys/pets/ccm.asp for more information on the CCM. GPA is normalized to a 4.0 scale. This variable utilizes "normalized" credits, which places the hours or credit units on a common scale so that credit units can be compared across institutions. See T5CNORMCRED for further information about credit normalization. Duplicate course records, created by the transfer of course credits to one or more additional institutions, are only counted once. Courses that are a part of a graduate program as well as courses that end after June 2016 or are not provided by a transcript are excluded from this calculation. 

SAS Logic: 
Where T5COURSEDUP = 0 and T5CCRSLEVEL ne 2, 
X5STEM3GPA = (Sum of T5CNORMQPT where T5CSTEM3FLG = 1) / (sum of T5CNORMATT).
If (no courses where T5CNORMATT ne -9) or (no courses where T5CNORMGRDE ne -9) or (all courses after June 2016) or (all courses have T5CRECRDFLG in (2 3 4)) or (all courses are T5CCRSLEVEL = 2) then X5STEM3GPA = -9;
else if (sum of T5CNORMATT = 0) or (no courses meet the specific criteria) then X5STEM3GPA = -7;
else if X5TRANRESP in (0 3) then X5STEM3GPA = -6;
else if X5TRANRESP = 2 then X5STEM3GPA = -8.
All courses with term end dates (or term start dates if end date is missing) after June 2016 have been excluded from this calculation. 

Sparse values recoded to similar values on the public use file.

Label:      Postsecondary Transcript: First year STEM enrollment (using SMART grant STEM definition): known credits attempted 

Description: 
Indicates the total amount of science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) credits attempted during the student's first year of postsecondary enrollment (using SMART Grant definition of STEM) as of June 2016.

Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts, HSLS:09 F2 (Second Follow-up data collection)
Applies To: Postsecondary transcript respondents.

Notes: "First year" refers to the first 12 months of postsecondary enrollment, not the first  academic year. The course codes identified as STEM for this variable are adapted from the National Science and Mathematics Access to Retain Talent (SMART) Grant Program, 34 C.F.R. 691.17(d). Further information about the SMART Grant program can be found here:
https://smartscholarshipprod.servicenowservices.com/smart. See T5CSTEM1FLG for further information about specific CCM codes used to indicate STEM courses based on the SMART grant definition. The 2010 College Course Map (CCM) is used to code these data. See https://nces.ed.gov/surveys/pets/ccm.asp for more information on the CCM. When postsecondary enrollment dates are not available from a transcript or a transcript was not received, dates are pulled forward from the second follow-up student interview for HSLS:09 (HSLS:09 F2). This variable includes an input variable that may have been modified in this manner. If X5PS1START is prior to high school completion (X5LASTHSMY) then this variable will include dual enrollment.  This variable utilizes "normalized" credits, which places the hours or credit units earned on a common scale so that credit units can be compared across institutions. See T5CNORMATT for further information about credit normalization. Duplicate course records, created by the transfer of course credits to one or more additional institutions, are only counted once. Graduate, transfer, dropped, advanced placement, or audited courses, are excluded from this calculation as well as  courses that end after June 2016 or are not provided by a transcript.  

SAS Logic: 
START DATE = X5PS1START. 
END DATE = START DATE + 12 months
Where T5COURSEDUP = 0 and T5CCRSLEVEL ne 2, 
X5STYR1ATT = Sum of T5CNORMATT where T5CSTEM1FLG = 1 and (START DATE < = T5CTRMENDDT < END DATE) and T5CNORMGRDE not in (-92 -93 -94 -95).
If (all courses after June 2016) or (all courses T5CCRSLEVEL = 2) or (all courses T5CRECRDFLG in (2 3 4)) or (all courses that meet the specific requirements have T5CNORMATT = -9) then X5STYR1ATT= -9;
else if X5TRANRESP = 1 then X5STYR1ATT= 0; 
else if X5TRANRESP in (0 3) then X5STYR1ATT = -6;
else if X5TRANRESP = 2 then X5STYR1ATT= -8.
All courses with term end dates (or term start dates if end date is missing) after June 2016 have been excluded from this calculation. If there are both valid T5CNORMATT values (e.g., 3) and missing values that meet specific criteria X5STYR1ATT ignores the missing values and only sums the valid values.

Description: 
Indicates student's total attempted credits during summer terms as of June 2016.

Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts
Applies To: Postsecondary transcript respondents.

Notes: Summer enrollment is defined as courses with a start date in May, June, July, or August, and an end date in June, July, or August of the same year. See T5CNORMATT for further information about credit normalization. Duplicate course records, created by the transfer of course credits to one or more additional institutions, are only counted once. Courses that are a part of a graduate program, ended after June 2016, or are not provided by a transcript are excluded from this calculation. Courses with a normalized grade of advanced placement, transfer, audit, or drop are excluded from this calculation. 

SAS Logic: 
Where T5COURSEDUP = 0 and T5CCRSLEVEL ne 2, 
X5SUMATT = Sum of T5CNORMATT where month of T5CTRMSTRDT in (5 6 7 8) and month of T5CTRMENDDT in (6 7 8) and year of T5CTRMSTRDT = year of T5CTRMENDDT and T5CNORMGRDE not in (-92 -93 -94 -95).
If (all courses after June 2016) or (all courses T5CCRSLEVEL = 2) or (all courses T5CRECRDFLG in (2 3 4)) or (all courses that meet the specific requirements have T5CNORMATT = -9) then X5SUMATT = -9;
else if X5TRANRESP = 1 then X5SUMATT = 0;
else if X5TRANRESP in (0 3) then X5SUMATT = -6;
else if X5TRANRESP = 2 then X5SUMATT = -8.
All courses with term end dates (or term start dates if end date is missing) after June 2016 have been excluded from this calculation. If there are both valid T5CNORMATT values (e.g., 3) and missing values that meet specific criteria then X5SUMATT ignores the missing values and only sums the valid values.

Label:      Postsecondary Transcript: Remedial mathematics courses: number known passed 

Description: 
Indicates the total number of known remedial mathematics courses passed during the student's postsecondary education as of June 2016.

Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts
Applies To: Postsecondary transcript respondents.

Notes: Duplicate course records, created by the transfer of course credits to one or more additional institutions, are only counted once. Courses that end after June 2016, are not provided by a transcript, or are a part of a graduate program should be excluded from this calculation as well. The definition of remedial was revised from ELS:2002 Postsecondary Education Transcripts Study. CCM Codes 23.1397 (Business English) and 27.9990 (Business Math) have been removed from the specific criteria based on recommendations by an expert panel. See T5CREMEDIAL for more information about remedial course designation. 

SAS Logic: 
Where T5COURSEDUP = 0 and T5CCRSLEVEL ne 2, 
X5REMMTHPS = Count if T5CREMEDIAL = 1 and (T5CCMCODE in (32.0104 27.9990) or (27.0194 < T5CCMCODE < 27.0199)) and (T5CNORMGRDE > 0.0 or T5CNORMGRDE = -98). 
If (all courses after June 2016) or (all courses T5CCRSLEVEL ne 2) or (all courses T5CRECRDFLG in (2 3 4)) then X5REMMTHPS = -9;
else if X5TRANRESP = 1 then X5REMMTHPS = 0;
else if X5TRANRESP in (0 3) then X5REMMTHPS = -6;
else if X5TRANRESP = 2 then X5REMMTHPS = -8.
All courses with term end dates (or term start dates if end date is missing) after June 2016 have been excluded from this calculation.

Description: 
Indicates the total amount of normalized college-level mathematics credits attempted during the student's postsecondary education as of June 2016.

Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts
Applies To: Postsecondary transcript respondents.

Notes: This variable utilizes "normalized" credits, which places the hours or credit units on a common scale so that credit units can be compared across institutions. See T5CNORMATT for further information about credit normalization. Duplicate course records, created by the transfer of course credits to one or more additional institutions, are only counted once. Courses that are a part of a graduate program, ended after June 2016, or are not provided by a transcript are excluded from this calculation. Courses with a normalized grade of advanced placement, transfer, audit, or drop are excluded from this calculation. The 2010 College Course Map (CCM) was used to code these data. See https://nces.ed.gov/surveys/pets/ccm.asp for more information on the CCM.

SAS Logic: 
Where T5COURSEDUP = 0 and T5CCRSLEVEL ne 2, 
X5CMTHATT = Sum of T5CNORMATT where T5CCMCODE in (27.0101, 27.0102, 27.0104, 27.0199, 27.0301, 27.0303, 27.0305, 27.0399, 27.0501, 27.0502, 27.0503, 27.0599, 27.9988, 27.9989, 27.9991, 27.9992, 27.9993, 27.9997, 27.9998, 27.9999) and T5CNORMGRDE not in (-92 -93 -94 -95).
If (all courses after June 2016) or (all courses T5CCRSLEVEL = 2) or (all courses T5CRECRDFLG in (2 3 4)) or (all courses that meet the specific requirements have T5CNORMATT = -9) then X5CMTHATT = -9;
else if X5TRANRESP = 1 then X5CMTHATT = 0;
else if X5TRANRESP in (0 3) then X5CMTHATT = -6;
else if X5TRANRESP = 2 then X5CMTHATT = -8.
All courses with term end dates (or term start dates if end date is missing) after June 2016 have been excluded from this calculation. If there are both valid T5CNORMATT values (e.g., 3) and missing values that meet the criteria then X5CMTHATT ignores the missing values and only sums the valid values.

else if X5TRANRESP = 1 then X5NRSERN = 0;

If there are both valid T5CNORMCRED values (e.g., 3) and missing values that meet the criteria then X5NRSERN ignores the missing values and only sums the valid values.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5POSTHSAY 
Position:   2479 
Length:     4 
Label:      Postsecondary Transcript: Academic year of first known postsecondary enrollment after high school completion. 

Description: 
Indicates the academic year associated with the first postsecondary enrollment after last attending high school. 

Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts, HSLS:09 F2 (Second Follow-up data collection)
Applies To: Postsecondary transcript respondents.

Notes: An academic year is defined to be July 1 through June 30. E.g., the 2013-14 academic year is comprised of July 1, 2013 through June 30, 2014. The value represents the last year of that particular academic year. For example, a value of 2014 indicates the data is for the 2013-14 academic year. This variable used X5LASTHSMY to determine the last date the student attended high school. It is possible for a student to leave a secondary institution, attend a postsecondary institution, then return to a secondary institution. In this scenario, postsecondary attendance would appear as dual enrollment. When postsecondary enrollment dates are not available from a transcript or a transcript was not received, dates are pulled forward from the second follow-up student interview for HSLS:09 (HSLS:09 F2). This variable includes an input variable that may have been modified in this manner. 

SAS Logic: 
If X5DUALDTFLG = 1 then X5POSTHSAY = -7;
else if (X5LASTHSMY (month) = "00" and X5LASTHSMY (year) = X5PS1START (year)) or X5PS1START (month) = "00" or only graduate enrollment then X5POSTHSAY = -9;
else if X5DUALDTFLG = 3 then X5POSTHSAY = academic year of X5PS1START;
else if X5TRANRESP = 1 and X5DUALDTFLG = 2 and X5PS1START > X5LASTHSMY then X5POSTHSAY = academic year of X5PS1START
else if X5TRANRESP = 1 and X5DUALDTFLG = 2 then X5POSTHSAY = academic year of the first undergraduate enrollment after X5LASTHSMY (using student/institution pair start and end dates as well as term start and end dates);
else if  X5TRANRESP = 1 then X5POSTHSAY = -9;
else if X5TRANRESP in (0 3) then X5POSTHSAY = -6;
else if X5TRANRESP = 2 then X5POSTHSAY = -8. 

Values of 2011 recoded to 2012 and values of 2018 recoded to 2017 on the public use file.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5SRRESP 
Position:   2483 
Length:     1 
Label:      Student Records: Student Record response status 

Description: 
Student's response status relative to the student records collection.

Source: 2017 Student Records Collection
Applies To: All students.

Notes: To be considered a respondent for the Student Records collection, it was required that 1) a primary first year institution was identified. (See X5PFYEAR or X5PFYINST for more information on this identification.) And, 2) some information reported about both state and institutional aid awarded while the student was enrolled at the primary first year institution. Note that the information received could have indicated that no state aid or no institutional aid was awarded to the student during that time. Federal aid information is also available through the National Student Loan Data System (NSLDS), so this information was not required to be reported from the institution. It should be noted that, for a small number of cases, sample members reported attendance in prior round interviews at one or more unknown/uncodable institutions that were subsequently determined to be non-postsecondary institutions. As a result, this variable may not be consistent with prior round composite variables that indicate postsecondary attendance. This variable does not provide an indicator of completeness or coverage of all student record data. For submission status of student record data, see I5SRSUBMIT and/or R5SRSTAT.

SAS Logic: 
If [student had reported postsecondary attendance post-high school] and [required state and institutional aid information was received from the primary first year institution] then X5SRRESP = 1;
else if [student had reported postsecondary attendance post-high school] and ([required state and institutional aid information was received from the primary first year institution] or [no primary first year institution was identified]) then X5SRRESP = 2;
else if [postsecondary attendance post-high school is unknown or our of scope] then X5SRRESP = 3;
else X5SRRESP = 0;
required institutional aid information: ((R5AIDAMT > 0 if R5AIDSOURCE = 1) or (R5YINSTAIDREC = 0 and (R5AIDTYPE^= -9 and R5AIDAMT ^= -9 if R5AIDSOURCE = 1))) where R5YPFYRECORD = 1;
required state information: ((R5AIDAMT > 0 if R5AIDSOURCE = 2) or (R5YSTAIDREC = 0 and (R5AIDTYPE^= -9 and R5AIDAMT ^= -9 if R5AIDSOURCE = 2))) where R5YPFYRECORD = 1.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5PFYEAR 
Position:   2484 
Length:     4 
Label:      Student Records: First academic year enrolled 

Description: 
First academic year student was enrolled in postsecondary education post high school.

Source: 2017 Student Records Collection
Applies To: Student Record respondents.

Notes: In most cases, the primary first postsecondary record is the institution and associated academic year with the earliest start date post-high school, based on Student Records (R5SENROLLSTR) and Transcripts (T5SENROLLST). Note an academic year is defined to be July 1 through June 30. E.g., the 2013-14 academic year is comprised of July 1, 2013 through June 30, 2014. An exception is made for the first institution (X5PFYINST), if (1) enrollment at the first chronological institution is during the summer (i.e., the enrollment begins in May, June, or July and ends by August); (2) the summer enrollment is in the same calendar year and follows high school completion/exit; and, (3) fall enrollment (i.e., the enrollment began in August, September, or October) is observed at a different postsecondary institution of that same calendar year, following high school completion/exit. If all the above conditions are met, the next institution with the next earliest start date is selected. Note that this exception is made in order to exclude summer enrollments immediately following high school completion/exit and immediately preceding fall enrollment at another institution. If there is any substantive gap between high school and summer enrollment, or summer enrollment and the next enrollment spell, no exception is made. Additionally, if enrollment is observed in both summer and fall at the same institution following high school, no exception is made.

An exception is made for the first academic year (X5PFYEAR) if the 1) first enrolled month is May or June and 2) enrollment is observed in September or October of the same calendar year at the same institution. In this case, the academic year with the September/October enrollment is selected. Note that this exception is made in order to exclude an academic year if the only enrollment observed is in the last two months of the academic year and that enrollment is immediately followed by fall enrollment.

To reconcile discrepant records across transcripts and student records, a primary first year record was identified separately within the transcript collection, then within Student Records. Ties both within source and reconciliations across sources were decided by taking the first record after sorting by academic year (ascending), the earliest enrolled month (ascending), months enrolled within the academic year (descending), and IPEDSID (ascending).

Students who do not have a last known high school date (X5LASTHSMY), will not have a primary first year record, since there is no threshold for determining post-high school enrollment. If a student does not have a month associated with the last known high school date  (X5LASTHSMY), any enrollment during the last known high school year is considered post-high school. (E.g., if the last known high school date is 201300, all enrollment on or after January 1, 2013 is considered post-high school.) If R5SENROLLSTR or T5SENROLLST indicate a student started college earlier than July 2012, the student will not have a primary first year record. Finally, if the first degree program was a graduate degree program, the student will not have a primary first year record.

SAS Logic: 
X5PFYEAR = ACADYEAR if R5YPFYRECORD = 1;
else if X5SRRESP = 1 then X5PFYEAR = -9;
if X5SRRESP in (0 3) then X5PFYEAR = -6;
if X5SRRESP = 2 then X5PFYEAR = -8. 

Values of 2012 recoded to 2013 on the public use file.

Category            Label                                              Unweighted          Unweighted 
------------------- ----------------------------------------- ------------------- -------------------

2015                2014-15 academic year                                     631                2.68

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5PFYENRLSTAT 
Position:   2502 
Length:     2 
Label:      Student Records: Known enrollment intensity at primary first year institution 

Description: 
Student's known enrollment intensity at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school.

Source: 2017 Student Records Collection
Applies To: Student Record respondents.

Notes: The known enrollment intensity at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school is derived from term dates and enrollment statuses as reported by the institution (R5YENROLLSTR where R5YPFYRECORD = 1). Institutions indicated whether the student was enrolled full time, 3/4 time, half time, or less than half time. For this variable, all categories less than full time are considered "part time." This variable was set to "1" if the student was enrolled full time for all months enrolled; set to "2" if the student was enrolled part time for all months enrolled; and set to "3" if the student was enrolled full time in some months and part time in some months. For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

SAS Logic: 
1. MFT = number of digits in R5SENROLLSTR = 1 where R5YPFYRECORD = 1;
2. MPT = number of digits in R5SENROLLSTR = 2, 3, 4 where R5YPFYRECORD = 1;
3. ALLM = MFT + MPT;
If MFT = ALLM then X5PFYENRLSTAT = 1 (Enrolled only full time);
else if MPT = ALLM then X5PFYENRLSTAT = 2 (Enrolled only part time);
else if MFT > 0 & MPT > 0 then X5PFYENRLSTAT = 3 (Mixed);
else if X5SRRESP = 1 then X5PFYENRLSTAT = -9;
if X5SRRESP in (0 3) then X5PFYENRLSTAT = -6;
if X5SRRESP = 2 then X5PFYENRLSTAT = -8.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5PFYTUITION 
Position:   2506 
Length:     5 
Label:      Student Records: Tuition and fees charged at primary first year institution 

Description: 
Tuition and fees charged while enrolled at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school. 

Source: 2017 Student Records Collection
Applies To: Student Record respondents.

Notes: This variable indicates the total tuition and fees charged at the primary institution during the first academic year in postsecondary education after high school completion or exit. The tuition as reported by institutions was the primary source, edited and adjusted for attendance status if necessary. That is, if the school did not report the exact tuition and fee amount charged to the student (R5YTUITFEECHG), the reported budgeted tuition (R5YBUDTUITFEE) was adjusted as needed to match the student's enrollment status (number of months enrolled full- or part-time). If tuition data were not available from institutions, tuition data were taken from the IPEDS Institutional Characteristics data collection corresponding with the student's primary first year and adjusted as needed to match the student's enrollment status (number of months enrolled full- or part-time). For example, if full-time full-year tuition was reported by the institution or in IPEDS, and the student was only enrolled for full-time for half the year, the tuition amount was adjusted down to represent full-time, half-year enrollment. Finally, if tuition amounts were not available from the institution or from IPEDS, the value was imputed using the group mean when grouping records by sector, attendance status, and residency for tuition purposes. For source information on this variable, see X5PFYTUITION_IM. For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

SAS Logic: 
For records where R5YPFYRECORD = 1, ACADYEAR_MINUS1 = ACADYEAR - 1;

TEMP_JURIS=R5YTUITRES if R5YTUITRES in (1,2,3);
else, TEMP_JURIS = 2.5 if R5YTUITRES == 4;
else, TEMP_JURIS = 2.5 if R5YINJURIS == 0;
else, TEMP_JURIS = 2 if  R5YINJURIS == 1;
else, TEMP_JURIS = 3 if R5YINJURIS == 2;

1. MFT = number of digits in R5SENROLLSTR = 1 where R5YPFYRECORD = 1;
2. MPT = number of digits in R5SENROLLSTR = 2, 3, 4 where R5YPFYRECORD = 1;
3. ALLM = MFT + MPT;

ATTNSTAT = 1 if MFT >= 9;
ATTNSTAT = 3.1 if MFT >= 1 & MFT <= 4 & MPT = 0;
ATTNSTAT = 3.2 if MFT >= 5 & MFT <= 8 & MPT = 0;
ATTNSTAT = 4 if ALLM >= 9 & MFT < 9;
ATTNSTAT = 6.1 if ALLM < 5 & MPT > 0;
ATTNSTAT = 6.2 if ALLM >= 5 & ALLM <= 8) & MPT > 0;

if R5YTUITFEECHG > 0 then  X5PFYTUITION = R5YTUITFEECHG;

else do, if R5YBUDTUITFEE > 0;
   if ATTNSTAT = 1 & R5YBUDPER = 1 then X5PFYTUITION = R5YBUDTUITFEE;
   if ATTNSTAT = 3.1 or 3.2 & R5YBUDPER = 2 then X5PFYTUITION = R5YBUDTUITFEE;
   if ATTNSTAT = 4 & R5YBUDPER in (3 5 7) then X5PFYTUITION = R5YBUDTUITFEE;
   if ATTNSTAT = 6.1 or 6.2 & R5YBUDPER in (4 6 8) then X5PFYTUITION = R5YBUDTUITFEE;

(Using IPEDS IC files)
else, if ATTNSTAT = 1, 
   if TEMP_JURIS = 1, then X5PFYTUITION = ic[acadyear_minus1]_FullInD;
   if TEMP_JURIS = 2, 2.5, or missing, then  X5PFYTUITION = ic[acadyear_minus1]_FullInS;
   if TEMP_JURIS = 3, then  X5PFYTUITION = ic[acadyear_minus1]_FullOutS;

TUITION_MEAN = average tuition value by I5SECTOR ATTNSTAT and TEMP_JURIS;

RATIO = (average tuition by I5SECTOR ATTNSTAT and TEMP_JURIS) / (average tuition by I5SECTOR and TEMP_JURIS where ATTNSTAT = 1);

Else;
   if TEMP_JURIS = 1, then X5PFYTUITION = ic[acadyear_minus1]_FullInD * RATIO;
   if TEMP_JURIS = 2, 2.5, or system missing, then  X5PFYTUITION = ic[acadyear_minus1]_FullInS * RATIO;
   if TEMP_JURIS = 3, then  X5PFYTUITION = ic[acadyear_minus1]_FullOutS * RATIO;

else if X5SRRESP = 1 then X5PFYINJURIS = -9;
if X5SRRESP in (0 3) then X5PFYINJURIS = -6;
if X5SRRESP = 2 then X5PFYINJURIS = -8. 

Sparse values recoded to similar values on the public use file. 

                                                                           Mean       Std Deviation 
Category                            Min                 Max          Unweighted          Unweighted 
------------------- ------------------- ------------------- ------------------- -------------------

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5PFYNETPRICEGRT 
Position:   2531 
Length:     5 
Label:      Student Records: Tuition and fees minus Title IV, state, and institution grants at primary first year institution 

Description: 
Tuition and fees minus federal Title IV, state, and institutional grants received while enrolled at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school.

Source: NSLDS:17; 2017 Student Records Collection; 2002-2012 IPEDS
Applies To: Student Record respondents.

Notes: Equal to tuition and fees (X5PFYTUITION) at the primary first year institution minus federal Title IV grants (X5PFYT4GRTAMT, from NSLDS:2017 and the 2017 Student Records Collection), institutional grants (X5PFYINGRTAMT, from the 2017 Student Records Collection), and state grants (X5PFYSTGTAMT, from the 2017 Student Records Collection) received while enrolled at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school. Grant aid helps cover the entire student budget, not just tuition, so it may be greater than tuition alone. This variable was set to zero if the total grant amount was greater than tuition and fees. For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

SAS Logic:

Applies To: Student Record respondents.

Notes: The Perkins loan is a campus-based, low-interest loan administered by the institution for undergraduate and graduate students who show exceptional financial need. Priority is given to Pell Grant recipients. The total annual Perkins loan cannot exceed $5,500 for undergraduate students between 2011-12 and 2016-17. For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

SAS Logic:

X5PFYPERKAMT = NDPERK if NDPERK > 0;
if X5PFYPERKAMT > 5500, then X5PFYPERKAMT equal to 5500;
Else, if CPERKINS > 0 and CPERKINS <= 5500 then X5PFYPERKAMT = CPERKINS;
if X5SRRESP = 1 and [the student's information was available to send to NSLDS for matching] then X5PFYPERKAMT = 0;
Else if X5SRRESP  = 1 and [the student's information was not available to send to NSLDS for matching] then X5PFYPERKAMT = -9;
if X5SRRESP in (0, 3) then X5PFYPERKAMT = -6;
if X5SRRESP = 2 then X5PFYPERKAMT = -8.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5PFYPELLAMT 
Position:   2601 
Length:     4 
Label:      NSLDS: Federal Pell Grants at primary first year institution 

Description: 
Total amount of federal Pell Grants received while enrolled at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school. 

Source: NSLDS:17
Applies To: Student Record respondents.

Notes: Pell Grants are need-based grants awarded to undergraduates who have not yet received a bachelor's degree and to students in teaching certificate programs. The Pell Grant amount depends on the expected family contribution (EFC), the price of attendance, and attendance status (i.e., full time or part time, full year or part year). The maximum Pell Grant in 2011-12 and 2012-13 was $5,550, $5,645 in 2013-14, $5,730 in 2014-15, $5,775 in 2015-16, and $5,815 in 2016-17. For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

SAS Logic: 
X5PFYPELLAMT = Sum of all AMT_PAID_TO_DT where AMT_PAID_TO_DT > 0 and TYPE = "PE" and AWARD_YR = X5PFYEAR from the HSLSNSLDSPELL file. Ignoring duplicates based on STU_ID, AWARD_YR, transaction number, DIS_DT, and AMT_PAID_TO_DT;
if X5PFYPELLAMT > 5550, then X5PFYPELLAMT = 5550;
else if X5SRRESP = 1 then X5PFYPELLAMT = -9;
if X5SRRESP in (0 3) then X5PFYPELLAMT = -6;
if X5SRRESP = 2 then X5PFYPELLAMT = -8.

Description: 
Total amount of Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant (SEOG) received while enrolled at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school. 

Source: 2017 Student Records Collection
Applies To: Student Record respondents.

Notes: The Supplemental Educational Opportunity Grant (SEOG) is a federal, campus-based grant for undergraduates who have not yet received a bachelor's or professional practice degree and show exceptional financial need. The grant is intended to supplement the Pell Grant and priority is given to Pell Grant recipients. The maximum SEOG was $4,000 in 2011-12 through 2016-17, with an exceptional limit of $4,400 for students participating in a study-abroad program that is approved for credit by the home institution. For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5PFYTEACHGRT 
Position:   2609 
Length:     2 
Label:      NSLDS: Federal TEACH grants at primary first year institution 

Description: 
Amount of TEACH Grants received while enrolled at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school.

Source: NSLDS:17
Applies To: Student Record respondents.

Notes: Teacher Education Assistance for College and Higher Education (TEACH) grants are available to students who are completing or plan to complete course work needed to begin a career in teaching. Spending caps imposed by the Budget Control Act of 2011 (also known as sequestration) limited the maximum award amount depending on award date. In rare cases, a student may appear to have received above the maximum grant amount because of crossover payment periods. Recipients must agree to teach in a high-need field at an elementary school, secondary school, or educational service agency serving students from low-income families for at least 4 academic years within 8 years after completing (or ceasing enrollment in) the course of study for which they received the grant. If this service is not completed, all TEACH grant funds are converted to a Direct Unsubsidized Loan. For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

SAS Logic: 
X5PFYTEACHGRT = Sum of all AMT_PAID_TO_DT (from HSLSNSLDSLOAN) where AMT_PAID_TO_DT > 0 and TYPE = "TG" and AWARD_YR = X5PFYEAR from the HSLSNSLDSPELL file. Ignoring duplicates based on STU_ID, AWARD_YR, transaction number, DIS_DT, and AMT_PAID_TO_DT;
else if X5SRRESP = 1 then X5PFYTEACHGRT = -9;
if X5SRRESP in (0 3) then X5PFYTEACHGRT = -6;
if X5SRRESP = 2 then X5PFYTEACHGRT = -8.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5PFYPELLPACK 
Position:   2747 
Length:     2 
Label:      Student Records: Aid package with Pell Grants at primary first year institution 

Description: 
Aid packages with Pell Grants received at the primary institution during the first academic year attended postsecondary education after high school. 

Source: NSLDS:17; 2017 Student Records Collection
Applies To: Student record respondents who received a Pell Grant while enrolled at the primary first year institution.

Notes: For students with any Pell Grants (X5PFYPELLAMT, from NSLDS:17), indicates combinations of federal campus-based aid (X5PFYCAMPAMT, from NSLDS:17 and the 2017 Student Records Collection), Direct Subsidized and Unsubsidized Loans (also known as subsidized and unsubsidized Stafford Loan, X5PFYSTAFFAMT, from NSLDS:17), and any other types of aid. Campus-based aid may be included in categories 5 & 6. For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

SAS Logic: 
X5PFYPELLPACK = 0 If X5PFYPELLAMT = 0;
if X5PFYPELLAMT = -9, then X5PFYPELLPACK  = -9;
if X5PFYPELLAMT > 0:
STAFFTEMP = 1 if X5PFYSTAFFAMT > 0; 
else STAFFTEMP = 0;
CAMPTEMP = 1 if X5PFYCAMPAMT > 0; 
else CAMPTEMP = 0;
OTHTEMP = 1 if [X5PFYTOTAID2 - (X5PFYPELLAMT + X5PFYCAMPAMT + X5PFYSTAFFAMT)] > 0; 
else OTHTEMP = 0;
if X5PFYPELLAMT > 0, then do:
PACKTEMP = (CAMPTEMP) + 2 * (STAFFTEMP) + 4 * (OTHTEMP);
       if PACKTEMP = 0 then PELLPACK = 1; /*Pell Grant only*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 1 then PELLPACK = 2; /*Pell and campus-based only*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 2 then PELLPACK = 3; /*Pell and Stafford only*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 3 then PELLPACK = 4; /*Pell, campus-based, and Stafford only*/;
       if PACKTEMP in (4,5) then PELLPACK = 5; /*Pell and other, no Stafford*/;
       if PACKTEMP in (6,7) then PELLPACK = 6; /*Pell and other, and Stafford*/;
else if X5SRRESP = 1 then X5PFYPELLPACK = -9;
if X5SRRESP in (0 3) then X5PFYPELLPACK = -6;
if X5SRRESP = 2 then X5PFYPELLPACK = -8.

Source: NSLDS:17; 2017 Student Records Collection

Notes: For students with any federal Title IV financial aid (X5PFYT4LNAMT2>0, X5PFYT4GRTAMT>0, or X5PFYCAMPAMT>0), indicates combinations of Pell Grants (X5PFYPELLAMT, from NSLDS:17), Direct Subsidized and Unsubsidized Loans (also known as subsidized and unsubsidized Stafford Loans) (X5PFYSTAFFAMT, from NSLDS:17), and federal campus-based aid (X5PFYCAMPAMT, from NSLDS:17 and the 2017 Student Records Collection). Other federal aid consists primarily of Direct PLUS Loans to parents of undergraduate students (X5PFYPLUSAMT, from NSLDS:17). For more information on identification of the primary first year and institution, see X5PFYEAR and X5PFYINST, respectively.

SAS Logic: 
If X5PFYT4LNAMT2 = 0 and X5PFYT4GRTAMT = 0 and X5PFYCAMPAMT = 0, then X5PFYFEDPACK = 0;
If X5PFYT4LNAMT2 > 0 or X5PFYT4GRTAMT > 0 or X5PFYCAMPAMT > 0, then FEDTEMP = 1; Else FEDTEMP = 0;
PELLTEMP = 1 if X5PFYPELLAMT > 0; Else PELLTEMP = 0;
STAFFTEMP = 1 if X5PFYSTAFFAMT > 0; Else STAFFTEMP = 0;
CAMPTEMP = 1 if X5PFYCAMPAMT > 0; Else CAMPTEMP = 0;
OTHTEMP = 1 if (X5PFYT4LNAMT2 - X5PFYSTAFFAMT > 0) or (X5PFYT4GRTAMT – X5PFYPELLAMT > 0); Else OTHTEMP = 0;
if FEDTEMP = 0 then FEDPACK = 0;
else if FEDTEMP = 1 then;
PACKTEMP = (PELLTEMP) + 2*(STAFFTEMP) + 4*(CAMPTEMP) + 8*(OTHTEMP);
if PACKTEMP = 1  then FEDPACK = 1  /*Pell only*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 2  then FEDPACK = 2  /*Stafford only*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 3  then FEDPACK = 5  /*Pell and Stafford*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 4  then FEDPACK = 3  /*Campus-based only*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 5  then FEDPACK = 6  /*Pell and campus-based*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 6  then FEDPACK = 8  /*Stafford and campus-based*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 7  then FEDPACK = 11 /*Pell, Stafford, and campus-based*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 8  then FEDPACK = 4  /*Other only*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 9  then FEDPACK = 7  /*Pell and other*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 10 then FEDPACK = 9  /*Stafford and other*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 11 then FEDPACK = 12 /*Pell, Stafford, and other*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 12 then FEDPACK = 10 /*Campus-based and other*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 13 then FEDPACK = 13 /*Pell, campus-based, and other*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 14 then FEDPACK = 14 /*Stafford, campus-based, and other*/;
       if PACKTEMP = 15 then FEDPACK = 15 /*Pell, Stafford, campus-based, and other*/;

else if X5SRRESP = 1 then X5PFYFEDPACK = -9;
If X5SRRESP in (0 3) then X5PFYFEDPACK = -6;
If X5SRRESP = 2 then X5PFYFEDPACK = -8. 

Values of 8 and 9 recoded to 14 on the public use file.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5T4XLNCUM 
Position:   2782 
Length:     5 
Label:      NSLDS: Total federal loans (excludes Parent PLUS Loans) borrowed through June 30, 2016 

Description: 
Total amount of all Title IV loans received through June 30, 2016. Excludes Parent PLUS Loans.

Source: NSLDS:17
Applies To: All respondents.

Notes: Equal to the sum of Perkins loans and federal Direct Loans received through June 30, 2016 (X5T4XLN12, X5T4XLN13, X5T4XLN14, X5T4XLN15, and X5T4XLN16, from NSLDS:17). This variable only includes Title IV loans, but excludes Parent PLUS loans. Federal Direct loans have annual loan limits for an academic year apply to all students and increase by academic level; however, academic years vary by institution and by program, which allows students to borrow more than the annual limit in the federal aid year (July 1 through June 30) and to progress to higher academic levels with higher borrowing limits within the federal aid year. Students can also receive more than the annual limit in the federal aid year if they have been awarded loans using a borrower-based academic year that does not coincide with a calendar year. Also of note, the federal Perkins loan program briefly expired on September 30, 2015 and was reinstated in December of 2015.

SAS Logic: 
If X5T4XLN12 >= 0 and X5T4XLN13 >= 0 and X5T4XLN14 >= 0 and X5T4XLN15 >= 0 and X5T4XLN16 >= 0, then X5T4XLNCUM = SUM(X5T4XLN12, X5T4XLN13, X5T4XLN14, X5T4XLN15, X5T4XLN16);
if (X5SRRESP = 1 or X5TRANRESP = 1) and [the student's information was available to send to NSLDS for matching] then X5T4XLNCUM = 0;
else if (X5SRRESP = 1 or X5TRANRESP = 1) and [the student's information was not available to send to NSLDS for matching] then X5T4XLNCUM = -9;

Name:       X5STSUB15 
Position:   2849 
Length:     4 
Label:      NSLDS: Direct Subsidized Loans 2014-15 

Description: 
Indicates the Direct Subsidized Loan (also known as subsidized Stafford loans) amount the respondent received for all enrollment during the 2014-15 academic year.

Source: NSLDS:17
Applies To: All respondents.

Notes: Direct Subsidized Loan annual loan limits for an academic year apply to all students and increase by academic level; however, academic years vary by institution and by program, which allows students to borrow more than the annual limit in the federal aid year (July 1 through June 30) and to progress to higher academic levels with higher borrowing limits within the federal aid year. Students can also receive more than the annual limit in the federal aid year if they have been awarded loans using a borrower-based academic year that does not coincide with a calendar year.

SAS Logic: 
X5STSUB15 = total dispersed (from HSLSNSLDSLOAN) to the student where LOAN_TYPE = "D0", "D1", or "SF" (Direct Subsidized Loans) from all institutions, during 2014-15;
if (X5SRRESP = 1 or X5TRANRESP = 1) and [the student's information was available to send to NSLDS for matching] then X5STSUB15 = 0;
else if (X5SRRESP = 1 or X5TRANRESP = 1) and [the student's information was not available to send to NSLDS for matching] then X5STSUB15 = -9;
if (X5TRANRESP = 0 and X5SRRESP = 0) or (X5TRANRESP = 3 and X5SRRESP = 3) then X5STSUB15 = -6;
if (X5TRANRESP = 2 or X5SRRESP = 1) and X5TRANRESP ^= 1 and X5SRRESP ^= 1 then X5STSUB15 = -8. 

Sparse values recoded to similar values on the public use file. 

                                                                           Mean       Std Deviation 
Category                            Min                 Max          Unweighted          Unweighted 
------------------- ------------------- ------------------- ------------------- ------------------- 
Continuous                        -9.00             8194.00              589.99             1449.45

Name:       X5STUNSCUM 
Position:   2857 
Length:     5 
Label:      NSLDS: Cumulative Direct Unsubsidized Loans through June 30, 2016 

Description: 
Cumulative amount of Direct Unsubsidized loans (also known as unsubsidized Stafford Loans) the respondent borrowed between the 2011-12 and 2015-16 award years.

Source: NSLDS:17
Applies To: All respondents.

Notes: Derived from variables: X5STUNS12, X5STUNS13, X5STUNS14, X5STUNS15, and X5STUNS16.

SAS Logic: 
If X5STUNS12 >= 0 and X5STUNS13 >= 0 and X5STUNS14 >= 0 and X5STUNS15 >= 0 and X5STUNS16 >= 0, then X5STUNSCUM = SUM( X5STUNS12, X5STUNS13, X5STUNS14, X5STUNS15, and X5STUNS16);
if X5STUNS12 < 0 and X5STUNS13 < 0 and X5STUNS14 < 0 and X5STUNS15 < 0 and X5STUNS16 < 0, then X5STUNSCUM = X5STUNS16 (Note, in this case, all components are equal.).

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X5PLUSAMT12 
Position:   2887 
Length:     2 
Label:      NSLDS: Direct PLUS Loans to parents 2011-12 

Description: 
Total amount of federal Direct PLUS loans to parents received for all the student's enrollment in 2011-12.

Source: NSLDS:17
Applies To: All respondents.

Notes: Direct PLUS loans to parents are available to the parents of dependent students in addition to any federal Direct Loans for which students are eligible. Direct PLUS loans to parents are not based on need and may be used to cover the federal expected family contribution (EFC). Although there is no fixed limit to the amount of a Direct PLUS loan to parents, it may not exceed the student budget minus any other financial aid classified for federal aid purposes as expected financial assistance. Direct PLUS loans to parents are only available to parents who can meet certain credit-worthiness criteria; if they cannot do so, then the dependent student for whom the loan is intended may apply to receive additional Direct Unsubsidized Loans up to a higher limit normally available only to independent students. 

SAS Logic: 
X5PLUSAMT12 = total dispersed (from HSLSNSLDSLOAN) to the student where LOAN_TYPE = "D4" or "PL" (Parent PLUS loans)  from all institutions, during 2011-12;
if (X5SRRESP = 1 or X5TRANRESP = 1) and [the student's information was available to send to NSLDS for matching] then X5PLUSAMT12 = 0;
else if (X5SRRESP = 1 or X5TRANRESP = 1) and [the student's information was not available to send to NSLDS for matching] then X5PLUSAMT12 = -9;
if (X5TRANRESP = 0 and X5SRRESP = 0) or (X5TRANRESP = 3 and X5SRRESP = 3) then X5PLUSAMT12 = -6;
if (X5TRANRESP = 2 or X5SRRESP = 1) and X5TRANRESP ^= 1 and X5SRRESP ^= 1 then X5PLUSAMT12 = -8. 

Variable suppressed with -5 values on the public use file. 

                                                                           Mean       Std Deviation 
Category                            Min                 Max          Unweighted          Unweighted 
------------------- ------------------- ------------------- ------------------- -------------------

Description:

Source: NSLDS:17

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X6LASTHSMY 
Position:   2988 
Length:     6 
Label:      X6 Last known date of high school attendance, as of June 2016 (PEAR update) 

Description: 
Indicates the respondent's last known date of high school attendance as of June 2016.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: PEAR sample.


Notes: This variable is an update to last known date of high school attendance from PETS (X5LASTHSMY) and adds high school attendance information from prior rounds for PEAR respondents who were not PETS respondents.


SAS Logic:
 Use the PETS student file. Derive s4lasthsdate using month and year variables, S4LASTHSMO and S4LASTHSYR.

Source: NSLDS:21


Applies To: All PEAR respondents.


Notes: Based on National respondent Loan Data System (NSLDS) loan data. Direct PLUS loans to parents are available to the parents of dependent students in addition to any federal Direct Loans for which students are eligible. Direct PLUS loans to parents are not need based and may be used to cover the federal expected family contribution (EFC). Although there is no fixed limit to the amount of a Direct PLUS loan to parents, it may not exceed the respondent budget minus any other financial aid classified for federal aid purposes as expected financial assistance.


SAS Logic:

 a. Create interim variables for 2011 through 2021 that are equal to TOT_DIS if loan_type=D4,PL and acad_lvl=1,2,3,4,5 (Parent PLUS loans)
 2. Sum up interim variables from 2011 through 2021 by CASEID to get X6PLUSAMTCM;
 Else if student is a PEAR respondent then X6PLUSAMTCM = -9;
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6PLUSAMTCM = -6;
 Else X6PLUSAMTCM = -8;

SAS Logic:

 2. Add AMT_DIFF to the interim values of Perkins loans if disbursement date occurs after July 1 of the previous year. Do this separately for undergraduate and graduate interim variables.
 3. Replace interim Perkins values with 5500 if greater than 5500.
 4. Sum up interim variables from 2011 through 2021 by CASEID to create X6PERKCM;

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X6ALLFBFB20 
Position:   3054 
Length:     2 
Label:      NSLDS: All federal student loans in forbearance, as of February 2020 

Description: 
Indicates whether all of the respondent's federal student loans were in forbearance as of February 29, 2020.


Source: NSLDS:21


Applies To: PEAR respondents who had outstanding federal student loans as of February 29, 2020.


Notes: A forbearance is a temporary cessation of loan principal payments under agreement with the loan servicer usually for financial hardship; interest continues to accrue. Excludes Parent PLUS loans. The cut point in time for this variable, February 2020, is based on when emergency relief for federal student loan borrowers went into effect as a result of the COVID 19 pandemic emergency. On March 13, 2020, the COVID 19 pandemic was declared a national emergency in the United States, and on March 27, 2020, Congress passed the Coronavirus Aid, Relief, and Economic Security (CARES) Act, which included emergency relief for federal student loan borrowers in the form of an administrative forbearance, a 0 percent interest rate, and paused collections on defaulted loans. The CARES Act applied only to federal student loans owned by the U.S. Department of Education that were not already in an excepted payment suspension status (e.g., in-school deferment, grace period, etc.) as of March 13, 2020. The emergency relief retroactively took effect on March 13, 2020; thus, February 2020 is the last month before federal student loan repayment was affected by the COVID 19 pandemic.


SAS Logic:
 If the amount owed on federal student loans, as of February 2020 variable has a value of -7 or 0, then set X6ALLFBFB20 to -7;
 else if the interim variable for all open loans in forbearance is 1, set X6ALLFBFB20 to 1;
 else if the interim variable for all open loans in forbearance is 0, set X6ALLFBFB20 to 0;
 else if student is a PEAR respondent then X6ALLFBFB20 = -9;
 else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6ALLFBFB20 = -6;
 else X6ALLFBFB20 = -8; 

Variable suppressed with -5 values on the public use file. 

                                                                        Frequency   Category            Label                                              Unweighted   ------------------- ----------------------------------------- -------------------   -5                  Suppressed                                             23,503

The U.S. Department of Education (ED) placed eligible ED-owned federal student loans not already in an excepted payment suspension status (e.g., in-school deferment, grace period, etc.) in administrative forbearance starting March 13, 2020. Cumulative amount paid is calculated for those who made payments while in administrative forbearance between March 13, 2020, and June 30, 2020. Payments of $0 between November 13, 2019, and February 29, 2020, as part of an income-based payment plan are only included if the borrowers made non-zero payments while in administrative forbearance between March 13, 2020, and June 30, 2020. Borrowers could opt out of the administrative forbearance program. Excludes borrowers who had at least one federal student loan not in administrative forbearance as of June 30, 2020. Also excludes Parent PLUS Loans.


SAS Logic:
 For students who made payments during and prior to administrative forbearance, X6FBCPAYFB20 is the sum of the payment amounts;
 else if student didn't make payments during and prior to administrative forbearance then X6FBCPAYFB20 = -7;
 else if student is a PEAR respondent then X6FBCPAYFB20 = -9;
 else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6FBCPAYFB20 = -6;
 else X6FBCPAYFB20 = -8; 

Variable suppressed with -5 values on the public use file.

Name:       X6DUALDTFLG

Label:      X6 Dual enrollment (based on dates), as of June 2021 

Description: 
Indicates whether the respondent was ever dual enrolled in high school and a postsecondary institution as of June 2021.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: All PEAR respondents.


Notes: This variable was created by using T6SSCHLORDR, T6S1STATMY, and T6SLASTATMY from the student-institution file. Dual enrollment is defined as a postsecondary course taken prior to high school completion for postsecondary credit. X6DUALDTFLG calculates whether a student had dual enrollment based off of the first- and last-attended dates at each institution. This variable used X6LASTHSMY to determine the last date the student attended high school. It is possible for a student to leave a secondary institution, attend a postsecondary institution, then return to a secondary institution. In this scenario, postsecondary attendance would appear as dual enrollment. This variable was not reconciled with the prior rounds HSLS:09 dual enrollment variables.


SAS Logic:
 If all nonnegative T6SSCHLORDR values = 0 then X6DUALDTFLG = 1;
 else if at least one T6SSCHLORDR value = 0 and at least one T6SSCHLORDR value > 0  then X6DUALDTFLG = 2;
 else if all T6SSCHLORDR values > 0 and any T6S1STATMY or T6SLASTATMY prior to X6LASTHSMY then X6DUALDTFLG = 2;
 else if all T6SSCHLORDR values > 0 and no T6S1STATMY prior to X6LASTHSMY and no T6SLASTATMY prior to X6LASTHSMY then X6DUALDTFLG = 3;
 else if all T6SSCHLORDR lt 0 or any T6SSCHLORDR > 0 where (X6LASTHSMY < 0 or T6SLASTATMY < 0) then X6DUALDTFLG = -9;
 else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6DUALDTFLG = -6;
 else X6DUALDTFLG = -8;

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X6ENROLLST 
Position:   3074 
Length:     2 
Label:      X6 Month-by-month enrollment level string (January 2011 - June 2021) 

Description: 
Indicates the respondent's enrollment level at all institutions with a 126-character string. The string spans January 2011 through June 2021 with each month represented by one character.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: All PEAR respondents.


Notes: This variable was created by using T6SENROLLST from the student-institution file. The student-institution file may contain multiple observations/rows for one student, corresponding to unique institutions attended. Each unique student-institution pair will have an associated enrollment level string. T6SENROLLST is the enrollment level string associated with each unique student-institution pair. X6INTENSITY is the overall enrollment level string that combines all enrollment-level-strings-by-institutions. X6ENROLLST is a 126-character string that represents whether a student was enrolled for each of the 126 months between January 2011 and June 2021. Each month is represented by a digit in the string, beginning with January 2011 through the final month. If enrollment during a given month is undergraduate level, the character representing that month = 1. If enrollment during a given month is graduate level, the character representing that month = 2. If enrollment during a given month is a combination of graduate and undergraduate level, the character representing that month = 3. If enrollment level is unknown, the character representing that month = 8. If no enrollment for that month, character representing that month = 0.


The student-institution file contains T6SENROLLST, which is the enrollment level string associated with each institution. For each student, create an overall enrollment string that combines all enrollment-level-strings-by-institutions.
 Look across all T6SENROLLST: If all known enrollment during a given month is undergraduate, the character representing that month = 1 (indicating undergraduate enrollment); else if all known enrollment during a given month is graduate, the character representing that month = 2 (indicating graduate enrollment); else if respondent has both UG and GR enrollment in same month, the character representing that month = 3 (both UG and GR enrollment); else if enrollment during a given month is unknown, the character representing that month = 8 (indicating unknown enrollment); else if no enrollment for that month, the character representing that month = 0; If a case has a combination of missing and valid enrollment, then only valid dates will be represented in the enrollment string;
 Else if a case had all missing T6SENROLLST then X6ENROLLST = -9;
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6ENROLLST = -6;
 Else X6ENROLLST = -8; 

Variable suppressed with -5 values on the public use file.

SAS Logic:

 else if no enrollment for that month, the character representing that month = 0.
 If a case has a combination of missing and valid enrollment, then only valid enrollment will be represented in the enrollment string;
 else if a case has all missing T6SINTENSITY then X6INTENSITY = -9;
 else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6INTENSITY = -6;
 else X6INTENSITY = -8;

Notes: Spring enrollment is defined as enrollment between January 2021 and June 2021. If the student was enrolled at multiple institutions in Spring 2021, priority was given to 4-year institutions. Respondents who completed a degree in Spring 2021 and had no enrollment after their Spring 2021 degree date are considered not enrolled. Degree records where T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and T6DEGREEDTE > 202106 were not counted as a received degree in the calculation of this variable. Due to conceptual differences in the derivation of enrollment and persistence, X6LASTENR21 may differ from X6ATPR and X6HIGHDEG.


SAS Logic:
 If enrollment anywhere between January 2021 - June 2021 (from X6ENROLLST) and either (didn't earn a degree between January 2021 - June 2021 (T6DEGREEDTE  = -7 or T6DEGREEDTE between 201101-202012)) or (earned a degree between January 2021 - June 2021 (T6DEGREEDTE has positive value) and had enrollment AFTER the degree date) then do;
 a) if enrollment between January 2021 - June 2021 at institution where I6LEVEL = 1 then X6LASTENR21 = 1;
 b) else if enrollment between January 2021 - June 2021 at institution where I6LEVEL in (2 3) then X6LASTENR21 = 2;
 c) else X6LASTENR21 = 3;
 else if no enrollment between January 2021 -  June 2021 or completed a degree between January 2021 -  June 2021 and had no enrollment after their degree date then X6LASTENR21 = 0;
 else if X6ENROLLST is missing then X6LASTENR21 = -9;
 else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6LASTENR21 = -6;
 else X6LASTENR21 = -8;

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X6TFNUM 
Position:   3114 
Length:     2 
Label:      X6 Total number of transfers between postsecondary institutions, as of June 2021 

Description: 
Indicates the number of times the respondent transferred institutions for undergraduate education before completion of their first known bachelor's degree as of June 2021.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: All PEAR respondents.


Notes: A transfer occurs when the respondent leaves one institution (the origin) and enrolls at another institution (the destination) for four or more months consecutively. A transfer is defined by the date of last enrollment at the origin school. It is not considered a transfer if the date of last enrollment at the origin school is after starting enrollment at the destination school. For example, if a respondent leaves school A, attends school B for a year, then returns to school A, this would not count as a transfer. Additionally,  students who co-enrolled in a second institution without leaving the first institution are not considered to be transfers. Calculations are based on undergraduate enrollment. This transfer definition does not consider undergraduate enrollment after the first bachelor's degree completion or whether course credits were accepted by the destination institution. Respondents who had never transferred by June 2021 were set to zero.


SAS Logic:
 For each schools attended after the first institution (T6SSCHLORDR > 1), using T6SENROLLST, if the number of months enrolled since left previous school is greater than or equal to 4 months, then increase the number of transfers by one. 
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6TFNUM = -6;
 Else X6TFNUM = -8; 

Values top coded to 3 on the public use file.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X6HIGHMON 
Position:   3124 
Length:     2 
Label:      X6 Highest known degree attained, as of June 2021: Time to degree in months 

Description: 
Indicates the number of months between the respondent's date of first known postsecondary education attendance after high school and the date of their highest degree completion as of June 2021.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: PEAR respondents who had postsecondary attendance after high school and completed a degree or certificate.


Notes: Degree records where T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and T6DEGREEDTE > 202106 were not counted as a received degree in the calculation of this variable. For a time to highest degree calculation that includes postsecondary enrollment exclusively during high school, see X6HIGHMON2.


SAS Logic:
 1. If X6DUALDTFLG = 1 or X6TOTCRED = 0, set to skip (-7);
 2. Else take the highest degree attained among all of the attained degrees through June 2021. If more than one of the same degree or certificate attained, use the earlier date of receipt.
 a) If X6PS1START occurs after high school completion/last date, X6HIGHMON = the difference between [X6HIGHDATE (highest degree date) and X6PS1START (start date)] in months, where X6HIGHDATE ne -9 and X6PS1START ne -9. 
 Else if X6PS1START occurs before high school completion/last date, X6HIGHMON = the difference between [X6HIGHDATE (degree date) and date of the earliest post-high school enrollment [first post-high school enrollment month in the string (X6SENROLLST) or earliest post-high school start date (T6S1STATMY), whichever comes first], where X6HIGHDATE ne -9 and (X6SENROLLST ne -9 or T6S1STATMY ne -9).  
 3. If highest credential was attained before first known post-HS enrollment or high school date, set X6HIGHMON to zero.
 4. Else if highest credential was attained before earliest PSE attendance after high school then do:
 a) if X6HIGHDEG in (1 2) then X6HIGHMON = 0;
 b) else X6HIGHMON = -9;
 Else if X6HIGHDATE is missing, set X6HIGHMON to missing (-9);
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6HIGHMON = -6;
 Else X6HIGHMON = -8; 

Variable suppressed with -5 values on the public use file.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X6HIGHINT 
Position:   3132 
Length:     2 
Label:      X6 Highest known degree attained as of June 2021: Enrollment intensity at institution of highest degree 

Description: 
Indicates the respondent's enrollment intensity at the institution of the highest known degree attained with a 126-character string. The string spans January 2011 through June 2021 with each month represented by one character.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: PEAR respondents who completed a degree or certificate.


Notes: This variable was created by using T6SINTENSITY from the student-institution file and T6DEGREE and T6DDEGRECVD from the degree-major file. The student-institution file may contain multiple observations/rows for one respondent, corresponding to unique institutions attended. Each unique student-institution pair will have an associated enrollment intensity string. T6SINTENSITY is the enrollment intensity string associated with each institution. X6HIGHINT is the enrollment intensity string (T6SINTENSITY) at the institution where the respondent attained their highest known degree or certificate as of June 2021. X6HIGHINT is a 126-character string that represents whether a student was enrolled for each of the 126 months between January 2011 and June 2021. Each month is represented by a digit in the string, beginning with January 2011 through the final month. If enrollment during a given month is part-time, the character representing that month = 1. If enrollment during a given month is full-time, the character representing that month = 2. If enrollment intensity is unknown, the character representing that month = 8. If no enrollment for that month, character representing that month = 0. Degree records where T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and T6DEGREEDTE > 202106 were not counted as a received degree in the calculation of this variable.


SAS Logic:
 If X6TOTCRED = 0, set to skip (-7);
 Else take the highest degree attained among all of the attained degrees through June 2021. If more than one of the same degree or certificate attained, use the earlier date of receipt. 
 If T6DEGREE in (7 12 13) and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHINT= T6SINTENSITY (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 11 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHINT= T6SINTENSITY (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 5 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHINT= T6SINTENSITY (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 8 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHINT= T6SINTENSITY (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 1 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHINT= T6SINTENSITY (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 2 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHINT= T6SINTENSITY (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 3 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHINT= T6SINTENSITY (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = -9 or T6DDEGRECVD = -9 or I6SECTOR (for corresponding I6IPEDSID) = -9 then X6HIGHINT = -9;
 else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6HIGHINT = -6;
 else X6HIGHINT = -8; 

Variable suppressed with -5 values on the public use file. 

                                                                        Frequency   Category            Label                                              Unweighted   ------------------- ----------------------------------------- -------------------   -5                  Suppressed                                             23,503

Applies To: PEAR respondents who completed a degree or certificate.


Notes: The categories are created using the 2010 Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP). See http://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/cipcode/ for more information on the CIP. An equivalent variable based on 2020 CIP codes was not derived due to little variation between 2010 and 2020 CIP classifications. Degree records where T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and T6DEGREEDTE > 202106 were not counted as a received degree in the calculation of this variable.


SAS Logic:
 If X6TOTCRED = 0 then X6CTECRED = -7;
 Else if first 4 digits of T6DMAJ1CIP or T6DMAJ2CIP ever in (0100 0101 0102 0103 0104 0105 0106 0107 0108 0109 0110 0111 0112 0199 0300 0301 0302 0303 0305 0306 0399 0400 0402 0403 0404 0405 0406 0408 0409 0410 0499 0900 0901 0904 0907 0909 0910 0999 1000 1001 1002 1003 1099 1100 1101 1102 1103 1104 1105 1106 1107 1108 1109 1110 1199 1200 1203 1204 1205 1299 1300 1301 1302 1303 1304 1305 1306 1307 1309 1310 1311 1312 1313 1314 1315 1399 1400 1401 1402 1403 1404 1405 1406 1407 1408 1409 1410 1411 1412 1413 1414 1418 1419 1420 1421 1422 1423 1424 1425 1427 1428 1431 1432 1433 1434 1435 1436 1437 1438 1439 1440 1441 1442 1443 1444 1445 1499 1500 1501 1502 1503 1504 1505 1506 1507 1508 1509 1510 1511 1512 1513 1514 1515 1599 1900 1901 1902 1904 1905 1906 1907 1999 1909 2200 2201 2202 2203 2299 2500 2501 2503 2599 2900 2901 2902 2903 2904 2999 3100 3101 3103 3105 3106 3199 3900 3902 3903 3904 3905 3906 3907 3999 4100 4101 4102 4103 4199 4300 4301 4302 4303 4399 4400 4402 4404 4405 4407 4499 4600 4601 4602 4603 4604 4605 4699 4700 4701 4702 4703 4704 4706 4799 4800 4803 4805 4807 4808 4899 4900 4901 4902 4903 4999 5004 5100 5101 5102 5104 5105 5106 5107 5108 5109 5110 5111 5112 5114 5115 5116 5117 5118 5119 5120 5121 5122 5123 5124 5125 5126 5127 5131 5132 5133 5134 5135 5136 5137 5138 5139 5199 5200 5201 5202 5203 5205 5206 5207 5208 5209 5210 5211 5212 5213 5216 5217 5220 5221 5299 5204 5214 5215 5218 5219 6001 6002 6003 6004 6005 6006) and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6CTECRED = 1;
 Else if all degree records with T6DDEGRECVD = 1 have no CTE CIP then X6CTECRED = 0;
 Else if (all degrees received have T6DMAJ1CIP in (-2 -9) and all T6DMAJ2CIP in (-2 -9)) or (all T6DDEGRECVD in (-2 -9)) then X6CTECRED = -9; 
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6CTECRED = -6;
 Else X6CTECRED = -8;

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X6CERTCRED 
Position:   3144 
Length:     2 
Label:      X6 Total number of known undergraduate certificates attained, as of June 2021 

Description: 
Indicates the respondent's total number of known undergraduate certificates attained as of June 2021.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: PEAR respondents who had undergraduate degree or certificate enrollment.


Notes: Degree records where T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and T6DEGREEDTE > 202106 were not counted as a received degree in the calculation of this variable.


SAS Logic:
 If X6EVRUGENR = 0, set to skip (-7);
 Else X6CERTCRED = Count of degree records where T6DEGREE = 3 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1. If T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and degree type is unknown or missing and degree was earned at a less-than-2-year institution, set X6CERTCRED to +1;
 Else if all records have missing T6DDEGRECVD  or (T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and degree type is unknown or missing and degree was not earned at a less-than-2-year institution), set X6CERTCRED to -9;
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6CERTCRED = -6;
 Else X6CERTCRED = -8; 

Variable suppressed with -5 values on the public use file.

Description:

Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: PEAR respondents who completed a bachelor's degree and had graduate degree enrollment.


Notes: This variable has not been reconciled with imputed X6EVRGRDENR.


SAS Logic:
 If X6BACCRED in (0 -7) or unimputed X6EVRGRDENR = 0, set to skip (-7);
 Else if a student has multiple BAs earned then take the most recent BA. For each student, look where any T6DEGREE = 1 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 (Received a bachelor's degree). X6MONPBAENRGR = the difference between most recent T6DEGREEDTE (BA degree) and X6ENRGRDT. If X6ENRGRDT < most recent BA date, set to 0;
 Else if BA degree date and graduate enrollment are missing then X6MONPBAENRGR = -9;
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6MONPBAENRGR  = -6;
 Else X6MONPBAENRGR  = -8;

Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: All PEAR respondents.


Notes: The Higher Education Act of 1965, as amended, defines an HBCU as: "...any historically black college or university that was established prior to 1964, whose principal mission was, and is, the education of black Americans, and that is accredited by a nationally recognized accrediting agency or association determined by the Secretary [of Education] to be a reliable authority as to the quality of training offered or is, according to such an agency or association, making reasonable progress toward accreditation." Federal regulations (20 USC 1061 (2)) allow for certain exceptions to the founding date.


SAS Logic:

Description: 
Indicates the respondent's known attendance intensity for all months enrolled through June 2021.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: All PEAR respondents.


Notes: This variable uses full-time, part-time, and unknown enrollment status from the overall month-by-month enrollment intensity string, X6INTENSITY. For information on how the overall month-by-month intensity string was derived and values in the string, see X6INTENSITY.


SAS Logic:
 Use X6INTENSITY: If enrolled full-time for more than 50% of enrollment months, set to 1;
 Else if enrolled part-time for more than 50% of enrollment months, set to 2;
 Else if enrolled full-time and part-time for an equal number of enrollment months and no months with unknown enrollment intensity (no 8s in X6INTENSITY), set to 3;
 Else if student is a PEAR respondent then X6ENRINT = -9;
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6ENRINT = -6;
 Else X6ENRINT = -8;

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       X6HIGHSLC 
Position:   3182 
Length:     2 
Label:      X6 Highest known degree attained, as of June 2021: Institution selectivity 

Description: 
Indicates the selectivity of the institution where the respondent attained their highest known degree or certificate as of June 2021.


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: PEAR respondents who completed a degree or certificate.


Notes: Selectivity was attained by admissions for the postsecondary institutions reported in 2002-2020 IPEDS and 2010 Carnegie classifications. The HSLS postsecondary institutional selectivity measure is based on the Integrated Postsecondary Education Data System (IPEDS) variable "CCUGPROF" (Carnegie Classification 2010: Undergraduate Profile). For more information about IPEDS please see https://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/. Degree records where T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and T6DEGREEDTE > 202106 were not counted as a received degree in the calculation of this variable.


SAS Logic:
 If X6TOTCRED = 0, set to skip (-7);
 Else take the institution selectivity of the institution where the highest degree was attained as of June 2021. 
 If T6DEGREE in (7 12 13) and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHSLC= I6SELC (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 11 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHSLC = I6SELC (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 5 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHSLC = I6SELC (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 8 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHSLC = I6SELC (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 1 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHSLC = I6SELC (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 2 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHSLC = I6SELC (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);
 else if T6DEGREE = 3 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6HIGHSLC = I6SELC (for corresponding I6IPEDSID);

Label:      X6 Any known degree received in STEM field (using NCES definition of STEM), as of June 2021 

Description: 
Indicates whether the respondent received a degree or certificate in a STEM field (using National Center for Education Statistics [NCES]  definition of STEM) as of June 2021 .


Source: HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Administrative Records, HSLS:09 Postsecondary Education Transcripts


Applies To: PEAR respondents who completed a degree or certificate.


Notes: For more details on how major fields of study are categorized, see Chen, X. 2009. Students Who Study Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) in Postsecondary Education (NCES 2009-161). U.S. Department of Education. Washington, DC: National Center for Education Statistics. http://nces.ed.gov/pubsearch/pubsinfo.asp?pubid=2009161. The 2010 Classification of Instructional Programs (CIP) is used to code these data. See http://nces.ed.gov/ipeds/cipcode/ for more information on the CIP. An equivalent variable based on 2020 CIP codes was not derived due to little variation between 2010 and 2020 CIP classifications. Degree records where T6DDEGRECVD = 1 and T6DEGREEDTE > 202106 were not counted as a received degree in the calculation of this variable.


SAS Logic:
 If X6TOTCRED = 0, set to skip (-7);
 Else if any degree record has T6DSTEM3FLG = 1 and T6DDEGRECVD = 1 then X6NCESSTEMCRED = 1;
 Else if all degree records with T6DDEGRECVD = 1 have T6DSTEM3FLG in (2 4) then X6NCESSTEMCRED = 0;
 Else if (all T6DSTEM3FLG in (-2 -9)) or (all T6DDEGRECVD in (-2 -9)) then X6NCESSTEMCRED = -9; 
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6NCESSTEMCRED = -6;
 Else X6NCESSTEMCRED = -8;

 else X6MONFRSTDEG2 = -8;

Notes: Date values are presented in a YYYYMM format. Enrollment exclusively at an institution while in high school (T6SSCHLORDR = 0) is not included in this variable. If HS date is missing or respondent has only graduate enrollment, set to missing.
 Else if X3SQSTAT<1 then X6PHSSTART = -6;
 Else X6PHSSTART = -8; 

Month portion recoded to 07 on the public use file.

S4OCC30RELATE_I=1 indicates that values of 1 were logically inferred for S4OCC30RELATE when S4OCC30 = S4JOBTITLE2, i.e. S4OCC30RELATE was logically inferred to be "closely related" when the job title for the respondent's expected occupation at age 30 was the same as the job title for their February 2016 occupation (or, if not working in February 2016, their most recent occupation).

                     30.1901, 30.2401, 30.2501, 30.2701, 30.3001, 30.3101, 42.2706)
       then stems(i)=1;
   else stems(i)=0;
end;

Label:      P2 D01 Parent 1's highest degree earned 

Description: 
In [Month and Year of base year interview], you indicated you had completed [parent 1's highest degree in base year]. Since that time, have you completed a higher level of education beyond [parent 1's highest degree in base year]?
OR
In [Month and Year of base year interview], you indicated you had not completed high school. Since that time, have you completed high school or a higher level of education beyond high school?
OR
What is the highest level of education [you/parent 1] [have/has] completed?
0=No, [you/parent 1] [have/has] not completed any other degree
1=Less than high school completion
2=Completed a high school diploma, GED, or alternative high school credential
3=Completed a certificate or diploma from a school that provides occupational training
4=Completed an Associate's degree
5=Completed a Bachelor's degree
6=Completed a Master's degree
7=Completed a Ph.D., M.D., law degree, or other high level professional degree

Note: The first version of the question was displayed if the first follow-up respondent was the same as the base year respondent and he/she had completed high school or a higher level of education in the base year.  The second version of the question was displayed if the first follow-up respondent was the same as the base year respondent and he/she had not completed high school in the base year.  The third version of the question was displayed under 3 conditions:  1) if a parent questionnaire was not completed in the base year, 2) if the first follow-up respondent was not identified as the same person as the base year respondent, or 3) if the respondents were the same but the highest level of education was not collected in the base year.  The conditional language in brackets (you/parent 1) depended on whether parent 1 was the respondent or another parent or guardian in the household.  See the Data File Documentation appendix E for a definition of parent 1.  If the education level for parent 1 was provided in base year, the lower level education options were not displayed. Item(s) included in the abbreviated paper and pencil questionnaire.

Administered To: Base year questionnaire non-respondents; first follow-up respondents who are not the same as the base year respondent; first follow-up respondents who were also base year respondents and reported a highest level of education in the base year less than a PhD, MD, law degree or other high level professional degree; first follow-up respondents who were also base year respondents and did not report their highest level of education in the base year
Programming Note:Values have been filled with the response from the base year parent interview when parent 1 is the same and the parent has not completed a higher degree than in the base year.  Because the response options do not entirely line up from base year to first follow-up, codes were mapped as 1 to 1, 2 to 2, 3 to 4, 4 to 5, 5 to 6, 6 to 6, and 7 to 7.
Crossround Note: This variable is a repeat of the BY variable P1HIDEG1.

File:       STUDENT 
Name:       P2HIMAJ1_STEM 
Position:   6746 
Length:     2 
Label:      P2 D02C Parent 1's major for highest level of education STEM code 

Description: 
Major STEM indicators are constructed using the following logic:

array majora P1HIMAJ61 P1BAMAJ61 P1HIMAJ62 P1BAMAJ62 P2HIMAJ61 P2HIMAJ62 
             M1HIMAJ6 M1BAMAJ6 N1HIMAJ6 N1BAMAJ6 
             A1HIMAJ6 A1BAMAJ6 A2HIMAJ6 A2BAMAJ6 
             C1HIMAJ6 C1BAMAJ6 S3FIELD6;
array majorn P1HIMAJ61n P1BAMAJ61n P1HIMAJ62n P1BAMAJ62n P2HIMAJ61n P2HIMAJ62n 
             M1HIMAJ6n M1BAMAJ6n N1HIMAJ6n N1BAMAJ6n 
             A1HIMAJ6n A1BAMAJ6n A2HIMAJ6n A2BAMAJ6n 
             C1HIMAJ6n C1BAMAJ6n S3FIELD6n;
array stems  P1HIMAJ1_STEM P1BAMAJ1_STEM P1HIMAJ2_STEM P1BAMAJ2_STEM P2HIMAJ1_STEM P2HIMAJ2_STEM 
             M1HIMAJ_STEM M1BAMAJ_STEM N1HIMAJ_STEM N1BAMAJ_STEM 
             A1HIMAJ_STEM A1BAMAJ_STEM A2HIMAJ_STEM A2BAMAJ_STEM 
             C1HIMAJ_STEM C1BAMAJ_STEM S3FIELD_STEM;
             
do i=1 to dim(majora);
   majorn(i)=majora(i);
   if majorn(i)<0 then stems(i)=majorn(i);
   else if majorn(i) in (99.9999) then stems(i)=-9;
   else if (01.0901 <= majorn(i) <= 01.1299) or
      (11.0101 <= majorn(i) <= 11.0501) or 
      (11.0701 <= majorn(i) <= 11.9999) or
      (14.0000 <= majorn(i) <= 15.0499) or
      (15.0503 <= majorn(i) <= 15.9999) or
      (26.0000 <= majorn(i) <= 27.9999) or
      (29.0000 <= majorn(i) <= 29.9999) or
      (40.0000 <= majorn(i) <= 41.9999) or
       majorn(i) in (03.0104, 03.0301, 03.0502, 03.0509, 03.0601, 03.3201, 
                     30.0101, 30.0601, 30.0801, 30.1501, 30.1001, 30.1601, 30.1801, 
                     30.1901, 30.2401, 30.2501, 30.2701, 30.3001, 30.3101, 42.2706)
       then stems(i)=1;
   else stems(i)=0;
end;
